messages:
sophie: Quick flag — scheduled bulk interviewer blocks for 48 candidates using /scheduler batch run and we got a bunch of 500s from the ATS API. Looks like none of the invites went out. Anyone free to triage?

devops-bot: Alert: scheduler-batch job batch-20260310-48 failed with 500s to greenhouse-api. Retries queued (3). Sentry: https://sentry.redwood/issue/6a7b

laura (Talent): Which env? Prod or staging?

sophie: Prod. job id: batch-20260310-48. Received 500s around 12:03pm PST. Partial log:
```
[12:03:07] POST /api/v1/invitations 500 {"error":"upstream_error"}
[12:03:08] retry 1 -> 502
[12:03:12] retry 2 -> 500
```

alexandra: @greenhouse-bot any incoming maintenance window earlier? Also did rate limit header show up?

greenhouse-bot: Notified: We had a brief degradation in EU region between 12:02-12:06 UTC due to db failover, returning 500s. Outage report: https://status.greenhouse.example/incidents/481

mike_recruit: Do we have a rollback plan for invites that didn't send? Candidates already had phone screens scheduled; need to avoid double invites.

sophie: Plan: (1) hold new scheduler batches until we confirm, (2) rebuild the list of candidates with missing invites via audit endpoint, (3) manual send for urgent ones. Can someone run `GET /internal/audit/batch/batch-20260310-48` and paste results?

alexandra: I'm on it — running audit now. If we need to requeue, we should add a small backoff + jitter in the scheduler to avoid thundering herd.

devops-bot: FYI created incident ticket #INC-3428 and paged platform oncall.

laura (Talent): Also let's schedule a 15-min sync with interviewing panel to pause auto-invites for the afternoon. Noted for interviewer training: remind interviewers to not assume invites are always delivered.

sophie: Thanks — I'll send the short pause message to #interviewers and add a note to the interviewer training checklist to verify invite receipt for same-day slots. :white_check_mark:

alexandra: Audit result: 48 candidates -> 48 API calls, 38 failed, 10 succeeded. Listing candidate ids in DM. Requeue suggestion: retry only the failed ones with exponential backoff. I'll open a PR to change scheduler behavior.

mike_recruit: Sounds good. Thanks team.
